content.text:
No. Ball1 passes through ring1 and strikes lever1. The lever reaches its 45° stop and successfully starts cart1 moving, but cart1 then collides with ring1 at about 0.54 s. It reaches only approximately 0.233 m of travel, reverses, and finishes at 0.171 m without touching domino1.

Domino1 remains upright, ball2 stays at the ramp entrance, and the downstream chain never starts. Ball3 shifts slightly into its guide but is not launched. Ball4 remains on shelf1 throughout; it never enters cup1.

The revised file moves cart1’s lane clear of ring1 and adjusts the lever horn and cart striker to preserve their contacts. This revision has not been rerun.
